name: Alavi 2026 supplementary materials (Zenodo 23105803): per-variant model classifications
description: The supplementary archive of Alavi 2026, holding Supplemental Tables IV to VI as workbooks. Table VI lists the 183 multi-gene test-set variants with their HGVS coordinates, which the preprint text does not. Retrieved for the dispute review of the AlphaGenome rows.

attributes.artifact_format: ZIP archive of three Office Open XML workbooks
limitations: Author-deposited supplementary data, not peer reviewed and not a publication in its own right.

Per-variant model calls only: the archive holds classifications ('pathogenic' or 'n.s.'), not the model scores or the thresholds, so the printed sensitivities and specificities cannot be recomputed from it.
The AlphaGenome columns were produced by the scripts carrying the 1-base coordinate offset reported in upstream issue #2, so those calls share the defect of the printed AlphaGenome results.
CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 forbids redistributing the workbooks, so they are not stored in this repository; the archive SHA-256 and classify-table-vi.py are the record.

review.reviewer_note: Recorded by a Claude agent for the 2026-10-23 dispute review (issue #174); no human review claimed. Extractor and reviewer were the same agent.
review.method_note: Every row of Supplemental Table VI was read from the workbook XML and classified by its HGVS coding offset with data/omics/alavi-alphagenome-dispute-20261023/classify-table-vi.py; the counts are that script's output in composition.tsv.
review.note: The preprint text was not changed by the author at the time of review; this records what its own supplement lists.

name: Multi-gene spliceogenic test set (Alavi 2026): attributes.population
description: The population said the 76 positives sit at canonical splice sites of 65 genes, which is the preprint's wording. Supplemental Table VI lists only 26 of the 76 at canonical ±1,2, and 64 gene symbols. Correction of a transcribed description against the source's own supplement; historical releases retain the previous value.

attributes.previous_value: 76 functionally validated spliceogenic substitutions at canonical splice sites of 65 genes from Bournazos et al. 2022 (RNA diagnostics in clinically accessible specimens) and Dawes et al. 2023 (SpliceVault), with 107 high-confidence ClinVar benign intronic substitutions from 46 of the 65 genes
attributes.value: 76 functionally validated spliceogenic substitutions across 64 gene symbols: 26 at canonical ±1,2 positions, 35 at near-splice intronic positions (+3 to +7, -3 to -7 and -13) and 15 exonic substitutions, from Bournazos et al. 2022 (RNA diagnostics in clinically accessible specimens) and Dawes et al. 2023 (SpliceVault), with 107 high-confidence ClinVar benign intronic substitutions at ±3 to ±10 from 46 of those genes
attributes.rationale: Supplemental Table VI lists each variant's coding coordinate. Of the 76 spliceogenic positives (Variant_type Donor or Acceptor) 26 sit at canonical ±1,2, 35 at near-splice intronic positions (+3 to +7, -3 to -7 and -13) and 15 are exonic substitutions with no intronic offset, so the positives are not canonical splice-site variants as the preprint's text describes them. The table carries 64 distinct gene symbols, not 65, and the 107 benign controls sit at ±3 to ±10 in 46 of those genes.
attributes.source_locator: Supplemental_Table_VI.xlsx, 183 data rows, columns A 'Gene Name', E 'Variant on Transcript' and F 'Variant_type'; preprint text 'constructed from 76 functionally validated, spliceogenic substitutions within the canonical splice sites of 65 genes [13, 14]'

name: Alavi 2026 AlphaGenome discrepancy review, revision 1: links
description: Revision 1 of the discrepancy review named six AlphaGenome results as its subjects. Those results are now disputed, and the release leaves out every record that links to a disputed one, so the claim now names the three multi-gene AlphaGenome evaluations those results belong to and the two multi-gene Borzoi evaluations, the other system of the discrepancy; historical releases retain the previous links.

attributes.rationale: scripts/omics/schema.ts publicRecords leaves out disputed records and every record linking to one. With the six results disputed, revision 1 would drop out of the release and the discrepancy's follow-up history would start at revision 2. Each of the six results belongs to one of the three AlphaGenome evaluations now linked. The two Borzoi evaluations are added because a resolved finding takes its compared systems from its review claims' subjects, and Borzoi is the other system compared.

review.reviewer_note: Recorded by a Claude agent for the 2026-10-23 dispute review (issue #174); no human review claimed. Extractor and reviewer were the same agent.
review.method_note: Checked that each previous subject result has an evaluation link to one of the three AlphaGenome evaluations now named, and that the two Borzoi evaluations are Alavi's multi-gene Borzoi rows.
review.note: No state, date or value changes.

name: Alavi 2026 AlphaGenome splicing discrepancy: confirmed error, results disputed
description: The author confirmed the 1-base coordinate offset in the AlphaGenome scripts, so the store marks the 42 AlphaGenome results of Alavi 2026 disputed and scopes an evidence concern to their nine evaluations. Its subjects are those evaluations and the Borzoi evaluations they were compared with. No corrected values exist yet.

attributes.rationale: The author labelled upstream issue #2 a bug on 2026-10-20 and reported that rerunning with the 1-based position substantially improved accuracy, which confirms the error behind the discrepancy. The 42 AlphaGenome results of Alavi 2026 (nine evaluations: three modules on the multi-gene set, the OPA1 evaluation sets and the extended OPA1 positive calls) are now disputed and the article carries an evidence concern naming those evaluations, so the discrepancy rules no longer compare them. Their printed values are kept. Superseding results will be added from the revised preprint.
attributes.upstream_response: On 2026-10-20 the author labelled the issue a bug and replied that running the splice scorer with the variant set to pos_1based substantially improved accuracy, promising updated scripts in calendar week 44 and a revised manuscript with updated data in early November 2026.
attributes.awaiting: The revised preprint with rerun AlphaGenome results, to add as superseding results.
